newsitem.title: USA: Starrett postpones annual meeting again.
newsitem.headline: Starrett postpones annual meeting again.

text.p: Starrett Corp said on Wednesday it was postponing its annual shareholder meeting again because the majority shareholders were still in discussions over a potential sale of their stake.

Some shareholders, including Starrett Chairman Paul Milstein, were in talks with real estate financial services firm Related Capital Co, to sell their 52 percent Starrett stake for $12 per share, the company said.
While Starrett Chief Financial Officer Lewis Weinfield said the company backed the sale, it was postponing its February 18 shareholder meeting until April 29.
"We feel good about the sale," he said. "One of our units already does building for Related."
The company had postponed an annual meeting set for December until February 18, he said.
